title: Menu stays open after going to a new page
what_happened: I tapped Donate with the menu open; the page changed underneath but the menu stayed covering most of my screen.
expected: The menu closes when I go to a new page so I can see it.

title: No way for an existing monthly donor to change their gift
what_happened: The whole Donate page only starts a new gift. Nothing in the menu or on the Donate page says 'already give monthly? change or pause your gift here', and there's no sign-in or donor portal link.
expected: A 'Manage my monthly gift' link (e.g. a Stripe customer portal sent by email link) or at least a line saying who to contact to lower a gift.

title: Contact page doesn't mention donors at all
what_happened: Contact Us has a general email, phone and a form, but the intro only talks about volunteering, partnering and programs. Nothing says 'questions about your gift? email X'. I'd have to write in and hope.
expected: A named donor contact or a 'change my donation' topic so I know I'm writing to the right place.

title: Home page news ticker rotates too fast to tap, titles cut off
what_happened: The only news I could see from the home page is a one-line ticker that keeps switching every few seconds. Titles are cut off ('Wel...', 'Where ...'), and it changed under my finger several times so I couldn't open the July 2026 Bulletin. There's no pause button and no 'News' item in the menu.
expected: A visible News/Stories link in the menu, and a ticker that stops when I touch it (or doesn't auto-rotate), with full titles.
